knownTraps: A shell path or folder named AxTask is not repository identity. Prove Git top-level plus the canonical origin before chaining worktree or fetch commands.

After a failed PowerShell expression such as (git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim(), do not continue with the null path; later git -C commands can misparse their next argument as a directory and obscure the original failure.
Preserve unknown dirty work and use an isolated worktree when the sprint does not own it.
Durable agent worktrees belong under the managed repository-sibling root; AppData/Local/Temp, os.tmpdir(), /tmp, and /var/tmp may hold caches but never unique sprint state.
Use workspaces.mjs create instead of freehand git worktree add or a second clone so workspace ownership remains inventoryable.
REMOVE is a request, not deletion proof: cleanup still requires a semantically clean secondary worktree whose HEAD is already an ancestor of current origin/main, and the branch is preserved.
Proven Git-attribute text CRLF/LF checkout noise is non-unique state; staged, untracked, semantic tracked, detached, branch-mismatched, or unmerged work always blocks cleanup.
Replit compatibility files and replit.md are not current deployment authority.
Repository or CI proof does not prove live Render, Neon, deployment, or operator acceptance.
A local-cert report is not live deployment proof: validate its sibling runtime-proof.json and honor proofCeiling before making deployment claims.
Production startup must not run interactive Drizzle schema push by default.
Use /health for DB-free liveness and /ready only for explicit database readiness.
Generated evidence belongs under ignored .ai/runs/ or .ai/generated/ paths; never track secrets, raw logs, workspace registries, or personal machine paths.
Validator selection is a plan, not proof that the selected commands executed.
Retention policy, runner code, and render.yaml cron wiring are repository proof only; require live Render evidence before claiming the trim job is instantiated, enabled, or recently successful.

Serverless is not an architecture requirement by itself. Stateful surfaces fail closed to KEEP/provisional until the ledger records evidence, one approved migration seam, validators, and proof ceiling.
Do not infer active cache/queue/runtime behavior from package dependencies alone; prove imports, initialization, producers, consumers, and failure semantics.
Prompts orchestrate work; application/domain behavior must remain executable in code and contracts.
